Engineering note

Keep the source attached

Why a task draft should keep the original note within reach.

A draft task can lose context when someone shortens or rewrites it. Fieldnotes stores the original line separately from the editable title so the reviewer can compare both.

Try the Fieldnotes demo with a line that names a reviewer without naming an owner. The draft gives you a place to clarify responsibility before sharing or exporting it.
